title: Primitives
note: Auto-classified by tools/build_concept_map.py — heuristic keyword scoring, tier by footprint.

Point.truth: a point is a decision: here, not there — but only inside a system.

Line / edge.truth: a line is the claim two things are connected — and the ruler that measures it.

Arrow / vector.truth: a line with a direction is an instruction, not a place.

Triangle.truth: three lines make the minimum enclosure — the first closed thing.

Plane / quad.truth: a flat surface: the field a shape is drawn upon.

The normal.truth: a surface has a FRONT: normals point, and the engine culls the back — walk behind a one-sided wall and it is not there.

Grid / array.truth: the grid is the commitment to discretize — to count space.

The seven words.truth: Box, Sphere, Cylinder, Capsule, Torus, Prism, Plane — the engine's whole primitive vocabulary; every body in this world is sentences made of these.

Cube / box.truth: the cube: six faces, the faceted unit of volume.

Sphere / ball.truth: the sphere: every point equidistant from a centre.

Cylinder.truth: a circle swept along a line.

Capsule.truth: a cylinder with hemispherical caps — the soft solid.

Torus / ring.truth: a solid with a hole — genus one, the first topology.

Platonic / polyhedra.truth: the regular solids: symmetry made into volume.

Cone / pyramid.truth: a base tapering to a point.

Prism / extrusion.truth: a 2D profile pushed through the third dimension.

The budget of smoothness.truth: a sphere is a polyhedron in a trench coat: radial_segments is the budget, smoothness the purchase.

Helix / spiral.truth: a line that climbs as it turns.

Arch / structure.truth: primitives composed into something that stands.

Curve / organic.truth: the smooth and the grown — designed and botanical form.

Text / glyph.truth: a primitive that carries a symbol.

Assembly / SDF / boolean.truth: primitives combined: union, subtraction, the assembler.

Everything is triangles.truth: under every solid here, triangles all the way down — the wireframe twin shows the seams.

Interactive tool.truth: a primitive you grab, drag, snap or edit.
